sections.title: Lab page styles
sections.what: Sets the layout and look for the moments list, call card, verdict, review columns, buttons, notebook tables and filters, and the dossier case file.
sections.why: Likely reason: groups the Lab's visual rules in one place.
sections.watch_out: Several buttons use a fixed minimum tap size, which should be kept for touch screens.

sections.title: Print rules
sections.what: When printing, hides navigation, the footer and items marked for no print, and makes the season file fit on paper.
sections.why: Likely reason: keeps printed or saved PDF results clean.
sections.watch_out: Details inside the season file are hidden when printed, so they will be missing from a printout.

summary: Styles for the Decision Lab pages: call cards, reviews, notebook, the dossier and print rules.
purpose: Keeps the Lab's look consistent across its pages.
why: Likely reason: Lab styles are kept separate from shared styles.
how: Sets grids and spacing for the moments list, call card, verdict box, review columns and buttons, with a minimum tap size. Also sets notebook filters and tables, the dossier layout and its open animation, and hides some items when printing.
inputs: Class names from the Lab components and theme variables defined elsewhere.
outputs: The visual layout of the Lab, and the print layout.
risks: Print rules hide items by class name, including navigation and footer. If those class names change, printed pages show extras. The open animation runs only when motion is allowed.
debug: If a Lab page looks broken, check class names in the component and that the shared variables exist. If a print looks wrong, check the print block.
